items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I did a record for Chaney Scott, did the thing called the Billie Holiday Story.

ctx.x: No, this is during that time after, see. And the Dukes of Dixieland, Roy Eldridge, Lionel Hampton, and then I did a record for Chaney Scott, did the thing called the Billie Holiday Story. They didn't release that because the Billie Holiday Foundation or whatever it was put a suit in and the record wasn't released. But he was in there.
